research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: www.bankmaspion.co.id now redirects to https://www.kasikornbank.co.id (the bank's new official site, a Next.js app with no bot protection). Every document was downloaded directly from the bank's own CDN (https://www.kasikornbank.co.id/cdn/f/...) on 2026-11-03 with curl and a browser User-Agent; document lists were read from the IR pages' embedded data (financial-reports?topic=annual|audited-financial|interim|quarterly, information-disclosure, general-meeting-of-shareholders). No Internet Archive copy and no news source was needed for any number. The FY2021 audited-FS link on the IR page is broken (redirects to a KBank Thailand page), so the audited FS2021 reproduced inside AR2021 (PDF pp. 418-420) was used and cross-checked against the FS2022 comparative column. Scanned statement pages (FS2022-FS2024 PDF pp. 5-6, AR2021 PDF pp. 419-420, the GMS notary resumes) were read from rendered page images; each value was cross-checked against the next year's text-layer comparative or the AR highlight table (all agree).

ENTITY / NAME: PT Bank Kasikorn Indonesia Tbk ('KBank Indonesia'), formerly PT Bank Maspion Indonesia Tbk (Surabaya, IPO 11 Jul 2013 as BMAS; ticker unchanged). The name change and the move of the registered seat from Surabaya to Jakarta Selatan (Pacific Century Place, SCBD) were approved by the AGMS of 20 May 2026 (notary resume PDF pp. 9-10, Agenda 9); the H1 2026 FS and published report are already headed 'PT Bank Kasikorn Indonesia Tbk (dahulu PT Bank Maspion Indonesia Tbk)'. Controlling shareholder: KASIKORN VISION FINANCIAL COMPANY PTE. LTD. (KVF, 100% KASIKORNBANK PCL, Thailand) 86.03%, KASIKORNBANK 2.45%, PT Kasikorn Vision Financial Indonesia 1.00%, public 10.52% (30 Sep 2026, IR shareholder page). KASIKORNBANK already held 443,901,808 shares (9.99%) before PUT II (PUT II summary prospectus PDF p. 1); KVF took control through the 2022 PUT II (62.35%, completed 7 Dec 2022) and raised its stake via the 2023 PMHMETD III. The founding Maspion-group holder PT Alim Investindo still held 13.89% at end-2024 (AR2024 PDF p. 565, FS Note 23) but is no longer listed among shareholders by Sep 2025. The bank has no subsidiaries, associates or JVs (AR2025 PDF p. 97), so the bank-only statements are the whole entity: money fields carry basis 'consolidated' (SCHEMA rule 3; same approach as BBHI/BBYB), ratios 'bank_only' as reported to OJK. Conventional bank (sharia=false). Auditors: Hendrawinata Hanny Erwin & Suwargo (FY2020), Tanubrata Sutanto Fahmi Bambang & Rekan / BDO (FY2025, H1 2026).

UNITS: all audited/interim statements are in Rp ribu (thousands) -> divided by 1e6, full precision kept. AR highlight tables are in Rp juta. The AR2024 highlight table rounds the FY2024 loss to (247,213) juta, but the audited statement prints (247,211,570) thousand (FS2024 PDF p. 6, FS2025 PDF p. 6): the audited figure is stored.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-now: two rights issues, both recorded: PUT II (100:94 at Rp410, ex 21 Nov 2022) and PMHMETD III (100:110 at Rp370, ex 3 Nov 2023). No stock split, reverse split, bonus issue or stock dividend: the share count reconciles exactly (4,443,461,538 + 4,176,853,845 = 8,620,315,383; + 9,482,346,921 = 18,102,662,304, unchanged through 30 Jun 2026; AR2025 PDF p. 97 listing chronology), so per-share history needs no adjustment factor. Pre-2019 (out of scope): IPO 2013 at Rp320 (770,000,000 shares), PUT I Oct 2016 at Rp340 (592,461,538 shares). No rights or bonus ex-date falls before 2020-12-31, so fy.2019.year_end_price is not stored (for reference only: AR2020 PDF p. 16 prints the Q4-2019 close as Rp358). The 12 Sep 2025 row 'Ketentuan Free Float' in the AR2025 listing chronology (983,732,793 shares at Rp500, total shares unchanged) is a free-float transaction in existing shares (public portion raised to 10.52%) - not a split/rights/bonus, so not a corporate_actions record.

UPCOMING RIGHTS ISSUE (NOT RECORDED, ex-date in the future): PMHMETD IV approved by the EGMS of 27 Aug 2026 (notary resume No. 292/Srt/VIII/2026). Summary prospectus of 8 Sep 2026 (https://www.kasikornbank.co.id/cdn/f/293514417727424/x/cc4001c7a9/prospektus-ringkas-pmhmetd-iv-bmas-2026-final-version.pdf, PDF pp. 1-2): 655 old shares -> 104 rights, exercise Rp350, up to 2,874,315,845 new shares (13.70% dilution), proceeds up to Rp1,006,010,545,750; standby buyer KVF. INDICATIVE schedule: OJK effective 13 Nov 2026, cum regular/negotiated 23 Nov 2026, EX 24 NOV 2026 (cash market 26 Nov), recording date 25 Nov 2026, rights trading 27 Nov - 3 Dec 2026. Add it to corporate_actions (type rights, ratio_old 655, ratio_new 104, price 350, ex_date 2026-11-24) once OJK declares it effective and the final schedule is published; shares_out would then rise to up to 20,976,978,149.

FREE FLOAT / THIN TRADING: at end-2024 the shareholder register (AR2024 PDF p. 565, FS Note 23) was KVF 81.10%, PT Alim Investindo 13.89%, KASIKORNBANK 2.45%, PT Guna Investindo 1.44%, PT Kasikorn Vision Financial Indonesia 1.00%, directors 0.00% and the public only 0.11%. AR2024 PDF p. 16 shows Q1 2024 volume of 68 shares and Q2 2024 of 0 (quarterly closes 535 and 500 barely moved). The free-float requirement was met on 12 Sep 2025 with a public portion of 10.52% (AR2025 PDF pp. 97-98; the listing-chronology row 'Ketentuan Free Float' shows 983,732,793 shares at Rp500, total shares unchanged). Daily prices for 2024 to mid-2025 are therefore stale/illiquid; the year-end closes stored are the AR's printed figures. Also note the 2021 rally (Q1 2021 low Rp332 -> high Rp2,760 in Q4 2021, AR2021 PDF p. 16) during the KBank/digital-bank speculation, with no corporate action behind it.

PROFITABILITY / LOSS YEAR: FY2024 is a loss year (net loss Rp247.2bn after Rp380.4bn impairment provisions; BOPO 120.13%, ROE -3.79%). FY2025 profit Rp31.8bn; H1 2026 profit Rp6.4bn vs Rp25.0bn in H1 2025 (general & administrative expenses Rp395.4bn vs Rp146.5bn, partly offset by Rp294.0bn 'Lain-lain' other operating income; FS PDF p. 6). The AGMS of 20 May 2026 also approved an updated Recovery Plan (Agenda 8, POJK 5/2024). Growth from FY2021 to FY2023 is dominated by the two KBank-funded rights issues (equity 1.33tn -> 6.72tn), not organic growth.

DIVIDENDS: the only cash dividend out of FY2020-FY2025 profit is the FY2020 final dividend of Rp7.5/share (Rp33,325,961,535; AGMS 31 Aug 2021; ex 9 Sep 2021; paid 1 Oct 2021; AR2021 PDF pp. 137-138). No dividend for FY2021 (AGMS 18 Jul 2022), FY2022 (AGMS 15 Jun 2023), FY2023 (AGMS 14 May 2024), FY2024 (loss; AGMS 27 May 2025) or FY2025 (AGMS 20 May 2026): payout_ratio v 0 with the AGMS source. The FY2020 payout ratio is null because no percentage is printed anywhere (amounts only; Rp33.3bn of Rp67.0bn). The validator will warn 'no dividend records' for FY2021-FY2023 and FY2025 - expected, there were none. Dividend policy: maximum 50% of net profit (AR2021 PDF p. 103).

RATIOS: all FY ratios are the OJK ratios printed in each year's own AR 'Rasio Keuangan' table (bank = whole entity); later ARs reprint the same values (checked AR2021-AR2025 three-year tables: no restatement found). ROE is consistent with the OJK definition (profit after tax / average Tier 1 capital): FY2025 31.8bn / ~6.2tn Tier 1 = 0.51%. CIR appears only from AR2023 ('Rasio Biaya terhadap Pendapatan'; FY2021 and FY2022 taken from AR2023's three-year table, FY2020 not disclosed). CASA % is stated only for FY2023-FY2025 (MD&A). CoC, LAR and NPL coverage are not disclosed in any AR, FS or published report; no analyst presentations exist. LDR: FY2025 146.36% and H1 2026 174.67% are real (loans funded by KBank borrowings and interbank funds while customer deposits fell); the H1 2026 value is above the validator's 160% plausibility bound and will show as a range warning.

KBMI: KBMI 2 since the Nov 2023 PMHMETD III lifted core capital above Rp6tn (AR2024 PDF p. 49: 'Bank masuk kedalam kategori KBMI 2 dengan modal inti lebih dari Rp6 Triliun'). Tier 1 at 31 Dec 2025 Rp6,182,308 juta (AR2025 PDF p. 131), only ~3% above the Rp6tn KBMI 2 threshold (POJK 12/POJK.03/2021). Before Nov 2023 the bank was KBMI 1 (AR2024 PDF p. 48).

INTERIM: H1 2026 (30 Jun 2026) is the latest published period; the 30 Jun 2026 statements are AUDITED (BDO TSFB, report dated Aug 2026, for the PMHMETD IV prospectus). Balance-sheet prior-year comparatives (30 Jun 2025 loans and deposits) come from the bank's own H1 2025 interim FS, because the H1 2026 statements compare with 31 Dec 2025. Ratios come from the OJK published quarterly report for 30 Jun 2026 (one-page PDF, 'Laporan Rasio Keuangan Triwulanan'); the PMHMETD IV summary prospectus (PDF p. 12, 'Analisis Rasio Keuangan') reprints identical H1 2026 ratios.
